subject: social_studies
concept: Writing an evidence-based comparative essay analyzing two different societal systems, citing specific sources
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a comparative essay using a two-column organizer for each system's features
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph comparing two systems, citing specific evidence for each

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph makes a genuine comparison supported by specific evidence for both systems
misconception_flags: describes each system separately without genuinely comparing them

interest_binding: systems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
